title: 2001 AMC 8 Problem 1
statement: Casey’s shop class is making a golf trophy. He has to paint \(300\) dimples on a golf ball. If it takes him \(2\) seconds to paint one dimple, how many minutes will he need to do his job?

solutions.text:
It will take Casey \(2\cdot300=600\) seconds to do the job. Since \(60\) seconds make one minute, this is \(600\div60=10\) minutes.

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: Convert the total painting time to seconds first
There are \(60\) seconds in one minute
